executiveSummary: Active targeting of Siemens S7 PLCs across multiple sectors (including Water/Wastewater) is confirmed; actors use automated scans and S7comm memory read/write to develop disruption capability. Immediate S7 hardening and segmentation are required. Security Advisory Volt Typhoon leveraged a covert "Silent Train" multi-hop access network and four zero-days against management/control-plane platforms (e.g., SD-WAN controllers) with impacts to U.S. critical infrastructure, including water and energy. Restrict and monitor management planes. View Article Widespread, actively exploited PHP RCEs (CVE-2026-109618/109619) enable webshell deployment on internet-facing portals (Drupal/WordPress/Joomla/Magento), raising pivot risk into CI environments. Patch or virtually patch immediately and hunt for webshells. View Article KEV Alert High-impact OT device issues: Advantech EKI-1242 industrial gateways with unauthenticated remote root and missing-auth critical functions; Danfoss iC7 drives expose unsigned update and debug paths. Isolate, block management ports, and plan urgent remediation. CISA Bulletin CISA Bulletin In-the-wild OS command injection in SiteGuard Server Edition (CVE-2026-106931) via a default-enabled feature enables root/SYSTEM takeover on perimeter servers, widely deployed in Japan. Disable statistics and update immediately. JPCERT Advisory Ransomware and state activity: SafePay ransomware is impacting hundreds of victims including CI; UNM Health experienced care disruption; U.S. multi-agency advisory highlights Chinese government-linked data theft using botnets and LOTL techniques. #StopRansomware View Article Advisory OT software maintenance: EPICS Base network parsing flaws and Mitsubishi/ICONICS DCOM misconfiguration issues warrant expedited patching and DCOM hardening for HMI/SCADA/historians. CISA ICS Advisory CISA ICS Advisory

vendors: Siemens S7 PLCs; Advantech EKI-1242; Danfoss iC7 drives; EPICS Base; ICONICS/GENESIS/Hyper Historian; eProsima Fast DDS; Oracle E-Business Suite; SiteGuard Server Edition; VMware ESX; Linux kernel; Adobe Commerce/Magento; Google Brotli; Collabora Online/CODE; various PHP-based CMS (Drupal/WordPress/Joomla/Magento); SD-WAN/management-plane platforms (Versa, Cisco, Arista VeloCloud, N-able).
sectors: Water and Wastewater Systems; Energy; Manufacturing; Transportation; Healthcare; Government Services; Telecommunications; Higher Education/Research (EPICS).

relevance: Direct OT impact: Siemens S7 PLC targeting; Advantech EKI-1242 gateways; Danfoss iC7 variable frequency drives; EPICS Base parsing flaws; ICONICS/Mitsubishi DCOM defaults; eProsima Fast DDS messaging risks. Security Advisory CISA Bulletin EPICS Advisory OT-adjacent/perimeter: Volt Typhoon control-plane exploits; SiteGuard RCE; Oracle E-Business Suite RCE probes; Collabora/CODE KEV; ESX/Linux KEVs (hypervisors, DMZ). View Article KEV Alert Enterprise-to-OT pivot vectors expanding via widespread PHP exploitation, ransomware activity, and management-plane abuse; strong IT/OT segmentation remains critical. #StopRansomware

items: EPICS Base ≤7.0.10 parsing flaws - DoS/memory disclosure/PCE; update to 7.0.11; isolate EPICS networks. CISA ICS Advisory
ICONICS/Mitsubishi GENESIS/Hyper Historian/DCOM defaults - over-broad DCOM permissions; patch to 10.98+, isolate legacy MC Works64. CISA ICS Advisory
Advantech EKI-1242(E)IMS - unauth RCE, missing-auth critical functions; block TCP 5058, segment, apply updates when available. CISA Bulletin
Danfoss iC7 drives - unsigned updates/debug interfaces allow code/firmware upload; segment, enforce secure updates. CISA Bulletin
eProsima Fast DDS - memory disclosure/DoS across industrial messaging stacks; upgrade and restrict DDS networks. CISA Bulletin
PHP RCE (CVE-2026-109618/109619) - active exploitation at scale; upgrade or virtually patch; hunt webshells. KEV View Article
SiteGuard Server Edition (CVE-2026-106931) - in-the-wild RCE via "statistics"; disable and update. JPCERT
Collabora Online/CODE (CVE-2026-110447) - OS command injection (KEV). KEV
VMware ESX (CVE-2026-41709) and Linux kernel (CVE-2026-46300) - active exploitation; patch, restrict mgmt interfaces. KEV
Adobe Commerce/Magento (CVE-2026-48356) and Google Brotli (CVE-2026-111497) - file upload / compression library exploit (KEV). KEV

descriptions: Exploit Public-Facing Application (ATT&CK T1190): PHP RCE; SiteGuard stats RCE; Oracle EBS SQLi; Collabora/CODE injection; SD-WAN/Orchestrator zero-days.
Valid Accounts / Credential Access (T1078/T1003): VPN/SSO abuse (SafePay); AD/Graph API abuse; credential theft following web compromise.
Command and Scripting Interpreter (T1059) and Web Shell (T1505.003): PHP webshells across portals; OS command injection on perimeters.
Tunneling/Exfiltration (T1572/T1041): Reverse SSH; chisel/frp tunnels; cloud storage exfil (RClone/OneDrive).
Living-off-the-Land (LOLBins): PsExec, WinRM, PowerShell, WMI for lateral movement and execution.
ICS ATT&CK: Inhibit Response Function and Manipulate Control (via S7comm writes; gateway/drive takeovers); Unauthorized Command Messages.

outlook72h: Expect continued mass scanning/exploitation of PHP RCEs with rapid webshell deployment; virtual patching will remain essential until full patches propagate. Increased probing of SiteGuard statistics endpoints likely in JP networks; watch for anomalous child processes on webservers. Ongoing reconnaissance against SD-WAN/orchestrators as actors seek durable footholds; look for short-lived tunnels and SSH key drops on appliances. Heightened risk of IT-to-OT pivot attempts where OT gateways/drives remain reachable from enterprise subnets; tune OT IDS for S7comm write attempts and OPC/DDS anomalies. Ransomware operators will opportunistically weaponize new KEVs (ESX/Linux/Adobe/Magento); validate isolation of hypervisors and DMZ services.
